videos.title: 3 Low-Code Ways to Ingest Data in Microsoft Fabric | File Upload, Dataflow Gen2, Copy Job
videos.description:
Want to get data into Microsoft Fabric without writing code? In this video, you can see 3 low-code ingestion methods:

File Upload: the fastest way to load CSV/Excel files into a lakehouse and turn them into tables
Dataflow Gen2: ingest and transform data with Power Query, then load it to a lakehouse or warehouse
Copy Job: bulk and incremental copying of many tables, no pipeline needed
